notes.title: Quality of Life Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

New Content
•	Difficulty modes (Story, Normal, Nightmare)

Gameplay
•	Bigger hit boxes
•	Increased health and experience drops
•	Improved particle effects
•	Giant Octopus’s ink puddles now damage the player
•	Rebalanced the game
•	Tougher fish have increased drops
•	Improved fish spawning
•	Sperm Whale is more aggressive
•	Squashed lots of bugs

Art
•	Improved fish and player visibility
•	Improved radiation barrel

Music
•	Improved game music

Achievements
•	New achievements
•	Improved achievement art
